architecture.candidate_generation: score all 20^4 four-residue amino-acid sequences excluding visible training variants; no hidden fitness used
architecture.dream_status: WARM if at least one pair-state is observed; DORMANT otherwise
architecture.frozen_semantics: same Memory + pair-residual Relative Resonance/Dream scorer used in GB1 V3
architecture.lambda_pair: median support across visible position-pair-state cells
architecture.lightning_score: additive memory + mean(weighted pair residuals over observed pair states)
architecture.main_shrinkage: n/(n+lambda_main), lambda_main = median support across visible position-state cells
architecture.pair_residual: visible pair-state mean minus global mean and shrunk main effects, then n/(n+lambda_pair)
architecture.relative_resonance_weight: abs(2*((rank-0.5)/N)-1) within each position-pair residual distribution
architecture.target_transform: log1p(nonnegative fitness); if published processed fitness can be negative, shift by visible-only minimum + epsilon before log1p and freeze that shift from visible data only

dataset.name: TEV protease 4-site combinatorial landscape
dataset.qc_rule: Use published processed true-activity rows with >=5 sequencing reads when such a read-support field is present. QC is outcome-independent.

integrity_note: TEV was selected specifically because no TEV landscape outcomes had been opened in this conversation before this preregistration.

matched_controls.ADDITIVE_MEMORY: same visible data and shrunk single-state effects, no pair resonance
matched_controls.RANDOM_HASH: SHA256('RANDOM|' + variant) lexical score; no fitness information
matched_controls.RIDGE_MAIN_PAIR: one-hot single + pair-state features; RidgeCV over fixed logspace alphas 1e-4..1e4, deterministic 5-fold KFold random_state=161
matched_controls.SHUFFLE_CONTROL: after primary candidate freeze, deterministically permute visible fitness with numpy seed 161 and rerun unchanged Lightning

strict_shareable_pass.gate_1: Lightning mean Top10 > every matched primary baseline
strict_shareable_pass.gate_2: Lightning mean Top5 > every matched primary baseline
strict_shareable_pass.gate_3: Lightning best recovered Top10 >= every matched primary baseline best recovered Top10
strict_shareable_pass.gate_4: At least 8/10 Lightning candidates have QC-eligible experimentally measured truth
strict_shareable_pass.gate_5: Shuffled-label Lightning mean Top10 <= 50% of true-label Lightning mean Top10

visible_training_selection.rule: Among QC-eligible distinct 4-AA variants, sort by SHA256('LIGHTNING_TEV_V5|' + variant) ascending; take first 588.
